item.description:
### Added - **Memory pressure, swap & Energy mode** — live macOS VM memory pressure (`Normal` / `Warn` / `Critical`) and SSD swap in the Memory card and menu bar, an **Energy** toggle on Top CPU, and battery wattage in the header - **Process Blacklist (Auto-Kill)** — automatically quit or force-kill recurring processes whenever they spawn, with pause/signal controls and core-system safeguards - **Background & Login Items inspector** — view registered LaunchAgents and LaunchDaemons, running status, and `.plist` locations - **Process drawer diagnostics** — inspect sleep-preventing assertions and live network sockets/ports, plus **Reveal in Finder** and **Copy Diagnostics**
### Changed - **Refreshed UI & instant tooltips** — redesigned Memory info card, Settings (with live menu-bar capsule preview), About, update dialog, app icon, and DMG installer with smooth animations and instant hover tooltips - **Faster, responsive startup** — window opens immediately with skeleton placeholders, cold launch shows live stats in under half a second, and the layout fits cleanly down to `940×620`
### Fixed - **Thermal & uptime coloring** — CPU die temperature gradients and long-uptime warnings now highlight reliably - **Updates & startup flash** — fixed update checks incorrectly reporting failures when up to date, and eliminated the white flash before the first frame paints
